_comment: Sensor registry for hum's event-driven trigger framework. Copy to data/hum-sensors.json. Each sensor is a cheap edge detector in agent/scripts/hum-sensors/ (or a personal one in agent/scripts/hum-sensors/_ext/) that answers 'did X just change?' and emits events; the gate in lib/hum-events.mjs decides whether the moment is worth an agent turn. Adding a trigger = one .mjs file + one entry here. Tuning = edit this file; the hum-sense daemon re-reads it every tick. See system/hum-events.md.

sensors.name: daypart
sensors.detects: crossing a boundary that changes what a useful suggestion looks like — day start, meal windows, work day ending, Friday afternoon

sensors.name: calendar
sensors.detects: a meeting just ended, an event with a place starts within 40 min, a long free window opened; also decides which current event holds hum (memo hold_id)
sensors.cost: 1 gog calendar call; a background model read for busy events over 3h

sensors.name: desk
sensors.detects: back at the Mac after a long absence (macOS only)

sensors.name: comms
sensors.detects: a wave of inbound mail since the last check

sensors.name: weather
sensors.detects: rain becoming likely / clearing, a temperature swing >=12F (needs EDVA_WEATHER_BIN)

sensors.name: idle
sensors.detects: nothing has dispatched for idle_fallback_min — the slow lanes' way in
